# Anhui Bowei Industrial Technology Co., Ltd.

> Hydraulic workholding fixture manufacturer · High-tech enterprise · ISO9001 certified · Hefei, Anhui, China

Bowei Industrial designs, manufactures and sells machining hydraulic workholding fixtures,
positioning & exchange systems, and non-standard automation equipment. Our core team has
20+ years of industry experience, with high-precision machines from Okuma (Japan), Hurco (USA)
and others, serving automotive parts, construction machinery, aerospace, medical and electronics industries.

## Facts

- Company: Anhui Bowei Industrial Technology Co., Ltd. (安徽柏威工业技术有限公司)
- Certifications: National High-Tech Enterprise, ISO9001, multiple patents

- Experience: 20+ years, 500+ completed projects

## Products

- [Hydraulic Fixtures](https://anhuibowei.com/en/hydraulic-fixture.html): Hydraulic workholding, 2-3s clamp/release, clamping deviation 1%-1.5%. Covers cylinder blocks/heads, oil pans, transmission housings, axles, track links. Compatible with Okuma, SW, Doosan, Mazak, Haicut, Tsugami machines.
- [Zero-Point Positioning](https://anhuibowei.com/en/zero-point.html): Repeatability ≤ 0.003mm, ultra-high-precision rapid changeover.
- [Ball-Lock Positioning](https://anhuibowei.com/en/ball-lock.html): Repeatability < ±0.013mm, instant positioning and clamping.
- [Exchange Tables](https://anhuibowei.com/en/exchange-table.html): Rapid workpiece/fixture exchange, higher machine utilization.
- [Automation Integration](https://anhuibowei.com/en/automation.html): Cobot integration, flexible manufacturing cells, non-standard automation equipment (turnkey).
